title: Famous People Born in February
author: Admin
excerpt: Meet some amazing people born in February who changed the world with science, courage, and sports!
content:
February is a special month because many famous and inspiring people were born during this time. Let’s meet a few of them and learn why they are remembered today!

  • Thomas Edison (born February 11, 1847)
    Thomas Edison was a great inventor who created the electric light bulb and the phonograph (a machine that plays music). He liked to experiment and try again and again until something worked. He once said that mistakes help us learn!

  • Charles Darwin (born February 12, 1809)
    Charles Darwin was a scientist who studied animals and plants. He traveled on a ship called the HMS Beagle and learned how living things change over time. His ideas helped people understand nature better.

  • Abraham Lincoln (born February 12, 1809)
    Abraham Lincoln was a president of the United States. He worked to keep his country united and helped end slavery. People remember him for being kind, honest, and brave.

  • Rosa Parks (born February 4, 1913)
    Rosa Parks was a brave woman who stood up for fairness. She refused to give up her seat on a bus and helped start a big movement for equal rights. Her courage helped change laws and hearts.
  • Michael Jordan (born February 17, 1963)
    Michael Jordan is one of the greatest basketball players ever. He showed that hard work, practice, and teamwork can lead to success. Many kids look up to him as a sports hero.

These February heroes remind us that anyone can make a difference in the world by being curious, brave, and kind. Maybe one day your name will be on this list too!
